title: Taramandur
description: Taramandur (Tara Mandura Guda) is a classic formulation where iron oxide is cooked with therapeutic herbs and jaggery (Guda) for easier assimilation. This classical formulation is primarily used for managing peptic ulcers (Parinama Shula) where stomach acid has eroded tissue. Addresses severe hyperacidity through alkalizing mineral content. Treats jaundice indicating liver dysfunction. Addresses anemia through iron supplementation.
